text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-87532 — capacity_exhaustion on /inference-queue-default. backlog=12k oldest_wait=4m error_rate=5% 503s. autoscaler failed to add nodes. Affected: hosted API (/v1/generate).
Priya: on call, ACKing. starting triage.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by Priya.
Liam: looking at autoscaler logs — keda controller shows provision API 403 quotaExceeded when creating nodegroup 'inference-pool'. scaling requests queued.
Jessica: quick impact summary: elevated 95th p99 latency, ~5% 5xx for generation endpoints; some customers seeing degraded throughput. Not a hard outage but user-facing errors. Posting dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/inference-queue
Priya: immediate plan: try hot-burst path from runbook, and manual scale as fallback. executing runbook step: `cloudctl compute instances create --pool inference-hotburst --count 8 --gpu-type a10`
Dave: quota increase requests to cloud provider are pending (usually slow). for now I'll enable fallback routing to us-west-2 dedicated burst pool and flip traffic for lower-tier hosts.
Liam: hotburst pool creation started but nodes stuck Pending due to image pull timeouts on startup. Kube events show `FailedScheduling` then `ImagePullBackOff` on new nodes. Working on forcing node image cache refresh.
Priya: manual horizontal scale applied to existing nodepool: +8 nodes (api call executed). queue drain in progress, monitoring backlog.
Jessica: drafting status page update: "We're seeing elevated errors and latency due to autoscaler capacity issues. Mitigation underway; some requests may return 503. We will update every 30 minutes." :warning:
Liam: backlog now 12k -> 5.3k after manual scale and routing changes. error_rate down to 1.7%. p95 latency improving.
Priya: tagging SRE infra team for follow-on: need fast image bake + prewarm hotpool. @Dave can you follow up on hotpool image issue?
Dave: on it. discovered older image manifest expiry causing slow pulls; pushing new manifest and restarting kubelet on the new nodes.
Liam: also found autoscaler metrics exporter missed a kube-apiserver token refresh — autoscaler thought capacity was still available. that's why scale requests queued. adding token-refresh check to runbook.
Priya: good catch. For immediate: keep manual nodes up until autoscaler healthy. If backlog < 1k in 20m we'll start draining extra nodes.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: escalation set for +30m if unresolved.
Jessica: customer comms sent to status page and key accounts.
Priya: update: backlog down to ~900. error_rate ~0.6%. moving to monitoring + postmortem.
Liam: initial RCA notes: autoscaler stalled due to two independent issues — cloud quota blocking new GPU allocations and token refresh bug causing scale controller to stop issuing new creates. short-term mitigations: manual scale + hotpool fallback + restart autoscaler. long-term: quota buffer, prewarmed hotpool, add token-refresh checks and alert.
Dave: filing infra GH: redwood/inference#1457 with remediation tasks and runbook updates.
Priya: thanks team. I'll close PD when we confirm stable for 1h and then write postmortem. reactions: :thumbsup: :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-87532 will auto-escalate if ack not renewed.
Jessica: leaving follow-up items: owners assigned in GH and schedule for capacity test next week.
Priya: final: monitoring window healthy, leaving extra nodes for 30m then draining if stable. will start postmortem draft.
